backend/main.mo: Actor initializes access control and approval state, mixes in authorization and blob storage, and defines an array of normalized worker service categories with subcategories.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing feature IDs, titles, related files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels for several frontend improvements.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of numerous frontend files covering styles, Tailwind config, landing components, i18n utilities, and registration/payment modules.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH color tokens, theming variables, and light/dark mode mappings with global border and body styling.
frontend/index.html: App entry HTML providing metadata, root mount div, and script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up React Query, i18n, TanStack Router routes for all main pages, and wraps content with header and footer in a shared layout.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminGuard: React guard component that checks Internet Identity login and admin status, showing login, loading, or access-denied UI before rendering protected content.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminJobPo: Admin list that loads pending or all job posts and allows approving or rejecting them.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminWorke: Admin list for reviewing worker registrations with approve, reject, verify, and feature actions.
frontend/src/components/common/SafeIconI: Image component that swaps to a fallback icon if the source fails to load.
frontend/src/components/i18n/BilingualTe: Renders paired English and regional-language text with optional styling.
frontend/src/components/i18n/I18nProvide: Provides fixed Tamil-focused i18n context and a lookup function for translations.
frontend/src/components/i18n/translation: Static dictionary mapping keys to English and Tamil translations.
frontend/src/components/jobs/JobBoard.ts: Displays a bilingual list of approved job posts with call buttons and labels.
frontend/src/components/landing/FooterBa: Footer showing bilingual text, WhatsApp contact, and branding info.
frontend/src/components/landing/HeaderBa: Responsive header bar with navigation links, mobile menu toggle, and bilingual text support.
frontend/src/components/landing/HeroSect: Empty placeholder file for a landing page hero section.
frontend/src/components/landing/HowItWor: Empty placeholder file for a landing page how‑it‑works section.
frontend/src/components/landing/Registra: Empty placeholder file for a modal used in landing page registration flows.
frontend/src/components/landing/SectionS: Empty placeholder wrapper for landing page sections.
frontend/src/components/landing/Testimon: Empty placeholder file for a testimonials section on the landing page.
frontend/src/components/landing/WhoCanJo: Empty placeholder file for a landing page section describing eligible users.
frontend/src/components/layout/PageShell: Layout wrapper applying consistent background, spacing, and container styling.
frontend/src/components/search/LiveSugge: Search box component providing debounced live suggestions, dropdown interactions, and mobile‑friendly behavior.
frontend/src/components/search/SearchEmp: Fallback UI showing suggestions and nearby workers when search results are empty, using geolocation and taxonomy data.
frontend/src/components/workers/WorkerCa: Worker profile card showing contact actions, skills, distance calculation, and trust indicators.
Static config listing local skilled worker subcategories with icons and bilingual labels.
frontend/src/config/payment.ts: Empty placeholder file for payment configuration.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages a backend actor using identity, handling access control initialization and query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminMutations.ts: Provides React Query mutation hooks for admin actions on workers and jobs, with error logging and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useBrowserGeolocation: Implements a geolocation hook with status tracking, timeouts, and a one-shot location fetch utility.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Defines an Internet Identity auth context and provider, handling identity loading, login, logout, and status management.
frontend/src/hooks/useLiveSearchSuggesti: Fetches live backend search suggestions with input sanitization, deduplication, and safe error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useNearbyWorkers.ts: Retrieves nearby workers and sorts them by haversine distance from a given location.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching workers, jobs, profiles, and admin status, plus job-creation mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollToSection.ts: Empty file placeholder for a scroll-to-section hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useWorkerSearch.ts: Performs worker search with sanitized filters, validating worker data and returning approved results only.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPage.tsx: Renders a blog listing page showing static posts with titles, metadata, and excerpts using card components.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Displays the homepage with a bilingual hero, live search, worker categories, and nearby worker suggestions based on geolocation.
frontend/src/pages/JobRequestPage.tsx: Provides a bilingual job posting form that validates inputs and submits a new job request via a mutation.
frontend/src/pages/WorkerRegistrationPag: Implements a worker registration form with validation, photo upload, taxonomy selection, and optional geolocation capture.
frontend/src/pages/WorkerSearchResultsPa: Handles worker search results using text or category filters, relevance sorting, grouping, and live search suggestions.
frontend/src/utils/bilingualFields.ts: Generates bilingual field labels by checking translation keys and falling back to humanized labels.
frontend/src/utils/bilingualTaxonomy.ts: Maps category/group variants to i18n keys and returns bilingual labels with fallbacks when translations are missing.
frontend/src/utils/categoryIcons.ts: Provides icon lookup for subcategories using normalized keys with a fallback icon.
frontend/src/utils/errors.ts: Extracts safe error messages and logs errors with context.
frontend/src/utils/humanizeLabel.ts: Generates human-readable labels and bilingual fallbacks, and validates translation outputs.
frontend/src/utils/normalizeTaxonomy.ts: Normalizes, deduplicates, and resolves canonical taxonomy strings.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Handles reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using URLSearchParams and sessionStorage.
frontend/src/utils/workerDistance.ts: Computes Haversine distance and formats it for display.
frontend/src/utils/workerRelevanceSort.t: Sorts workers by tag match, area match, and recent activity using normalized comparisons.
frontend/src/utils/workerSubgrouping.ts: Groups workers into predefined subgroups for construction and tailoring based on normalized subcategories.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration enabling dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color system, extended radius/shadows, accordion animations, and typography/container/animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state describing a multilingual hyperlocal services platform (AREA WORKARS) with design rules, UX requirements, category/icon constraints, and a list of known UI/architecture issues.
